journeys.intent: Choose an effort and privacy level
Recover from empty or accidental input
Repair a fact-losing or highly overlapping draft

explorations.knowledge_state: Owns the ideas and facts, understands no detector internals or product routes.
explorations.task_wording: I want a genuinely new version of this text without installing something or sending it to another mystery service, and I cannot afford to lose the facts.
explorations.contamination: Prospective route knowledge; runtime confidence reduced.

attempts.hypothesis: The opening should explain privacy and limits before asking for source text.
attempts.expected: A local-processing statement and no certification claim.
attempts.actual: The opening states the local boundary and rejects private-detector certification before the source field.

attempts.hypothesis: The prominent source field should start the preparation flow.
attempts.action: Paste a source and inspect protected values.
attempts.actual: Date and price appeared as protected values before sealing, with no external request during the journey.

explorations.outcome: critical local path completed with recovery
explorations.evidence_boundary: Behavior is observed in automated local browser runs. Felt trust still requires human research.

explorations.knowledge_state: Understands AI writing but not watermark sampling or this repository.
explorations.task_wording: Show me every sensible way to handle this and tell me which one is worth my time.
explorations.contamination: Prospective route knowledge; runtime confidence reduced.

attempts.hypothesis: A complete ladder should expose effort, privacy, strength and weakness together.
attempts.expected: Choose a route without reading the research dossier first.
attempts.actual: README and method ladder expose obvious, browser, agent, local, algorithmic and human routes with explicit costs.

explorations.outcome: method set and comparison language observed
explorations.evidence_boundary: Content and runtime are observed. Fastest label comprehension still requires user research.

findings.title: Source separation must stay visible and reversible

evidence.supports: Empty recovery, source sealing, unsealing and deliberate two-click reset passed in the local browser journey.

findings.user_impact: An opaque transition could look like data loss or leave the writer copying the old wording.
findings.target_behavior: Sealing creates a visible brief, keeps protected facts visible and offers unseal or reset.
acceptance_criteria: Empty input cannot seal and receives a text instruction.
No source is uploaded or persisted by default.
verification: Walk J-001 and J-003 by keyboard at desktop and mobile widths.

surfaces: Rewrite Room source and brief steps
instructions: Use an explicit reversible seal action and retain source in memory only.

findings.title: Comparison must explain trade-offs without detector theater

evidence.supports: The fact-loss fixture named the missing date and showed separate comparison signals without detector certification.

findings.user_impact: A single magic score would create false certainty and hide fact loss.
findings.target_behavior: Name each local check, list missing facts and recommend a concrete revision.
acceptance_criteria: Missing protected values are listed exactly.
verification: Run clean, highly overlapping and fact-losing candidate fixtures.

instructions: Render plain-language checks and revision actions separately.
